notes.id: Biaya gelombang 1 setelah diskon (biaya sebelum diskon ada di sorotan Instagram @rabbaanii_official). Uang pangkal sudah termasuk seragam 5 stel (TK 4 stel), buku paket tahun pertama, SPP Juli 2027, dan uang tahunan. DP minimal 25%, sisa maks. 4 bulan. Uang pangkal tidak dapat dikembalikan bila mengundurkan diri. Boarding khusus putra. Uang pangkal Rp24.800.000 (umum) / Rp22.800.000 (alumni/keluarga). Uang tahunan Rp3.500.000.
notes.en: Wave 1 prices after discount (pre-discount prices are in the @rabbaanii_official Instagram highlights). The entry fee includes 5 uniform sets (TK: 4), first-year textbooks, July 2027 tuition and the annual fee. Minimum 25% down payment, the rest within 4 months. Non-refundable if you withdraw. Boys' boarding only. Entry Rp24,800,000 (general) / Rp22,800,000 (alumni/family). Annual fee Rp3,500,000.
